changes.quantity: increase in required fund obligation over the prior required amount

cfr490-obligate.reason: Section 490.317(e)(1) specifies a 2 percent increase over the prior amount. The legacy 102 percent ratio and minimum comparison obscured the specified increment and its exact equality.

changes.missing_capability: conditional eligibility based on agency determination

hif18022-unpaved.reason: The cited process requires confirmation and Division Office concurrence before treating unresolved reported sections as excluded unpaved or other surface types. The v1 class set alone omits that condition.
